workflow: Multiple isolated execution contexts concurrently initialize the same process-wide lookup tables for a shared data-conversion facility.
Each context assumes initialization is local or independently safe and writes optimized handlers into the shared tables.
The unsynchronized writes overlap, forming a data race on shared initialization state.
Race-detection instrumentation reports the conflicting access instead of allowing concurrent initialization to complete normally.
summary: Concurrent initialization races on shared process-wide tables
decision_reason: The failure is materially the same as concurrent isolated contexts racing on shared process-wide state; the shared tables and initialization context are implementation details.
